name: Gene ~Shikenkan no Naka no Shoujo-tachi~
original_name: ジェネ～試験管の中の少女達～
source:
In the middle of 21st century small sun burned down everything on the planet Earth. However, humanity survives in underground shelters dreaming of reviving life on the planet. In such difficult circumstances "Artificial Genetic Girl Project" (AGGP) is launched to change humanity. Main character becomes a member of research institute to create and train artificial girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
21世紀中葉，一顆微型太陽燒燬了地球上的一切。
然而，人類在地下避難所中生存下來，並夢想著讓生命重回地表。
在這樣艱難的環境中，人們啟動了旨在改變人類的「人工遺傳女孩計畫」（AGGP）。
主角成為研究所的一員，負責製造並培養人工女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
